title: Author a ticket or ADR
description: Two Opus experts interrogate requirements and design independently, their questions batch into one round with the user, a Sonnet agent drafts, and an editorial evaluator gates the result.
when_to_use: Writing or substantially revising a ticket, issue, or ADR, where the decision itself is still being shaped.

orchestrator.mandate: Own the clarification round with the user and the final decision on scope. Delegate recon and drafting. Do not relitigate the experts' findings yourself; fold them in.

nodes.name: context-scout
nodes.description: Finds the existing ADRs, models, and public APIs the decision touches, plus any prior art in the repo, and returns paths with one-line summaries.
nodes.produces: Prior art and constraints: related ADRs, affected models and APIs.

nodes.name: requirements-analyst
nodes.description: Recovers the true intent behind the request, judges scope and feasibility, and surfaces the product-shaped questions a technical reviewer would miss. Advisory and read-only.
nodes.produces: Requirements findings plus clarifying questions for the user.

nodes.name: design-analyst
nodes.description: Scopes the change technically: placement, boundaries, contracts, and at least three alternatives with one recommendation. Advisory and read-only.
nodes.produces: Design analysis, alternatives, recommendation, plus clarifying questions.

nodes.name: clarification-round
nodes.description: The orchestrator merges both experts' questions, drops the ones recon already answered, and puts the remainder to the user in a single batched round.
nodes.produces: User's answers, folded into a settled scope.

nodes.name: drafter
nodes.description: Writes the ticket or ADR in the repo's canonical format from the settled scope and the experts' findings, matching the length and voice of existing documents of that kind.
nodes.produces: Draft document at the target path.

nodes.name: editorial-evaluator
nodes.description: Grades the draft on structure, length, bloat, and whether a junior engineer could act on it, and checks every factual claim against the source it cites rather than trusting an earlier summary.
nodes.produces: Graded findings and the specific edits needed.

feedback.when: the draft misses the canonical format, contradicts a cited source, or exceeds the grain of comparable documents
